name: Hanabishi Rikka
source:
A very serious, calm girl who is good at taking care of others.
She is like the mother of the class; she is not only kind but when someone does something bad, she will say so, like a mother who is kind yet strict.
Cherished for her thoughtfulness toward others, she stands at the heart of class with [url=/c16862]Mayuri Kousaka[/url] in terms of influence.
Because she was the top scoring student on the entrance exam, along with her caring and her ability to make things happen, she was named the class president.
She takes pride in the fact that she can handle all that is expected of her, takes initiative, and devotes herself to the role.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
